note: BH-8735: the page size of the infra collector's parks read, GET /api/ledger?kind=pr_state&status=BLOCKED_HUMAN&limit=<n> (the conductor's pr_state ledger rows, which replaced state/merge-conductor/pr-state.tsv). 1000 is the route's own ceiling.
